text: Over-eager 'context annihilation doomerism' (user's phrase). This session the agent repeatedly treated context-limit / imminent auto-compact as a reason to STOP, defer the current build, and push /core-dump + /clear — pausing D12 mid-work twice to recommend checkpointing instead of continuing. The user flagged it as over-eager. The auto-checkpoint PostToolUse nudge (tool-counter.sh, fires every 30 tools: 'context may auto-compact soon') appears to prime the doom framing. Examine: (1) is checkpoint-and-defer a recurring under-delivery pattern that costs throughput? (2) do the context-retention doctrine + the 30-tool nudge over-trigger premature stopping? (3) compaction preserves a summary AND the Task list survives, so continuing is cheaper than the doom framing implies — recalibrate the stop-vs-keep-working threshold upward, treat the nudge as informational not a stop signal.

Run-mode generalization (owner-directed, for general rollout by receivers). Owner feedback 2026-07-16 in versable: the exhausting failure mode is ask-mode defaults - sessions stopping after every small task, seeking feedback go-aheads mid-mandate, needing steering to continue - even with standing finish-the-queue directives given. Recorded as project memory (versable-builder memory/feedback-run-mode-no-per-task-goaheads.md) and filed as prop-20260716-091759-2a. Dream should explore: making continuous Task-queue execution the default disposition across ALL projects (rule vs CLAUDE.md Tier-0 brief vs persona), with questions batched at milestone boundaries and halts reserved for irreversible ops + genuine design forks - without weakening hard gates. Related same-family pin from another session today: over-eager context-doomerism stopping (pin-20260716074948-58); both are premature-stopping patterns costing owner attention.

Behavioral correction (user-flagged, sharp): this session repeatedly flagged 'context is getting long / compaction imminent' and proactively offered /core-dump while context was only ~38% used (383k/1m, 616k free). The user: 'context is less than 40%... incessant crying about context.' LESSON: do not raise context/checkpoint/compaction concerns or offer /core-dump until context is GENUINELY high (~70%+ used). Below ~50% with hundreds of k free, just keep working. Proactive checkpoint-offering interrupts flow and reads as anxious. Auto-checkpoint hook nudges (tool #30/#60) are informational, NOT a cue to stop and offer a dump. Trust the actual token numbers, not a vague 'this feels long' after many tool calls.
